HymnOverride.title: HymnOverride
HymnOverride.description: Represents a verified and updated version of a hymn saved to the shared cloud registry.

id.description: The unique numerical identifier of the hymn

number.description: The traditional number of the hymn

category.description: The liturgy category of the hymn

chorus.description: The optional chorus text of the hymn

author.description: The verified traditional author of the hymn

tune.description: The optional tune assignment for the organ output

melody.description: The optional array of validated Note structures representing the 100% accurate melody notes

isVerified.description: Whether the hymn has been verified with 100% accuracy using the Gemini traditional engine

verifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp indicating when the accuracy scan occurred

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was synchronized

hymn_overrides.description: Collection of traditional hymn overrides that have been scanned and corrected by users.
